incident: The learning compiler selected HISTORICAL_REPLAY, SHADOW and CANARY requirements, but policy promotion was not yet database-blocked when required evaluation evidence was absent.
root_cause: Evaluation mode was advisory output of powerhouse_learning_compiler_v1 rather than a state-transition invariant on powerhouse_policy_versions.
prevention_rule: A policy version may enter promoted only when the existing learning compiler's required evaluation mode has GREEN evidence bound to the exact candidate policy version and effect snapshot.

related_incidents.observation: Required and Shared Agent Memory detected tests/regulatory-organism-feed.test.mjs existed but was referenced by no workflow, so the regression contract never executed.
related_incidents.root_cause: A new regulatory organism regression was added without updating the explicit CI lane inventory.
related_incidents.prevention: Run the regulatory organism regression in the canonical backend lane; delivery-test-coverage-guard remains the fail-closed detector for future orphan tests.

related_incidents.observation: The terminal BRAIN admission for PR #2299 rejected tests/regulation-writer-candidate-mode.test.mjs as an unclassified delivery path after that stale regression was repaired.
related_incidents.root_cause: The test was historically wired into lane-automation by exact path but its filename did not conform to the canonical Brain/backend classifier namespace.
related_incidents.prevention: Place the regression at tests/brain-regulation-writer-candidate-mode.test.mjs and update the exact lane-automation reference; classifier and coverage guard then agree on one canonical path.

related_incidents.observation: Portal lane still expected the removed portalMainMenu and desktop-hidden hamburger while current Portal V2 uses portalFullMenuToggle as the canonical visible desktop/mobile menu.
related_incidents.root_cause: Regression and topbar helper retained legacy menu assumptions after the canonical full-menu UX moved into app.js/navigation.css.
related_incidents.prevention: Remove obsolete portalMainMenu runtime binding and assert portalFullMenuToggle plus desktop/mobile inline-flex visibility as the single canonical hamburger contract.

related_incidents.observation: Recovery #2310 inferred the regulatory writer still had a weekly schedule from predecessor history, while current canonical main had already removed that schedule.
related_incidents.root_cause: The recovery decision used predecessor evidence instead of re-reading the current canonical workflow before encoding a regression assertion.
related_incidents.prevention: Before every recovery patch, read the exact current-main implementation and derive tests from current canonical state plus invariant behavior; never promote predecessor assumptions into a new regression contract.

related_incidents.observation: PR #2312 proved canonical production readback and skill projection, but terminal evidence posted production_readback_verified=false because the canonical-run success path did not emit steps.production.outputs.verified.
related_incidents.root_cause: The descendant-live fallback emitted verified=true, while the canonical production-readback success branch omitted the same output, creating asymmetric terminal evidence semantics.
related_incidents.prevention: Every terminal production-readback success mode must emit a shared verified=true output before durable evidence submission; terminal evidence must fail closed if that output is absent.
